name: com.netease.nimlib.service.NimReceiver
description: In builds that implement it, Android starts this Receiver on network changes and, in some older releases, after device boot; the NetEase Yunxin IM SDK then tries to resume its background connection when a saved login exists. Some bundled Flutter releases contain an empty version.
disableEffect: The SDK may not automatically resume background message delivery after a network change or, in older builds, a device reboot.
